tool.name: PyEuk report
tool.description: render a self-contained graphical HTML report from a cluster SWEEP.json, PyEuk report

param.name: sweep_json
param.label: Cluster SWEEP.json
param.help: A *_SWEEP.json written by the PyEuk cluster tool (its sweep output). Holds the supported cluster-count range, the per-branch confidence tree, and the stable cores.

param.name: matrix
param.label: Distance matrix (optional)
param.help: The distance matrix from the same run. If given, the report adds a tree-ordered distance heatmap. Omit to skip the heatmap.

param.name: flavor
param.label: Layout
param.option: dashboard -- at-a-glance tiles, tree, sweep, heatmap

param.name: theme
param.label: Theme
param.option: galaxy -- system fonts, no external assets (for viewing inside Galaxy)
studio -- Fraunces/Inter via Google Fonts (for standalone viewing)

tool.help:
**Render a clustering report as one self-contained HTML page**
Takes the ``*_SWEEP.json`` that the PyEuk cluster tool produces and renders it as a single HTML file: the supported range of cluster counts, whether that count is determined, a per-branch confidence tree with the stable cores drawn on it, and -- if you pass the distance matrix -- a tree-ordered distance heatmap.
The page has no JavaScript and, in the **galaxy** theme, no external assets at all, so it displays correctly inside Galaxy. Use the **studio** theme for a standalone page (it links Google Fonts).
This tool only re-renders an existing sweep. To produce the sweep in the first place, run the **PyEuk cluster** tool; it can also emit this report directly as a side output. @HELP_FOOTER@
